content.title: The 12 Zodiac Signs In Order and What Each One Means
content.text: Credit: Tomekbudujedomek/Getty Images The zodiac is organized into 12 signs in a fixed order, starting with Aries and ending with Pisces. Each sign is associated with an element (fire, earth, air, water), a mode (cardinal, fixed, mutable), a ruling planet, and a corresponding astrological house. Whether you’re a total newbie to astrology or you know even some of the more intricate details of your birth chart, it can never hurt to brush up on the basics. After all, the 2,000-plus-year-old practice is one that even professional astrologers spend a lifetime learning about. So if you’re wondering what it really means if you were born when the sun was moving through air sign Libra or your Ascendent is of an earthy element, you’ll undoubtedly want to better understand each sign’s traits. For example, a fiery sign with lots of initiative? That's Aries, which is the first sign of the zodiac—a.k.a. the initiator. Just look to Lady Gaga, the ultimate go-getter, as an example. A delicate sign in the middle of the zodiac, Libra is more about striking a balance and living in harmony (lookin' at you, Bella Hadid). And dreamy Pisces, like Rihanna, tend to have their heads in the clouds. They're often considered the babies of the zodiac since they are the last sign. Below, find all 12 zodiac signs in order, the house they’re associated with, and additional basic details on each. Zodiac signs are symbolic divisions of the sky used in astrology. The astrological sky, also called the ecliptic, is based on the circular path the sun takes across the sky over the course of a year. This celestial pie is then divided into 12 equal segments that seat each zodiac symbol. A person's unique sun or moon sign distinguishes the exact position of the planetary body at their time of birth. For example, if the sun was in Cancer at the time of their birth, that person's sun sign is Cancer. The distinct characteristics of each zodiac sign are influenced by their element and mode. The 12 signs are equally divided into groups of elements—earth, air, water, and fire. Each element imbues the respective signs within its dominion with its own set of character traits. Earth signs reflect a grounded and stable presence, for example, while water signs swim through the very depths of emotion. Similarly, there are three modalities or quadruplicities: cardinal, fixed, and mutable. These refer to the seasonal cycles. Cardinal signs, for example, are found at the start of each season and embody a fresh, initiating energy. In contrast, mutable signs live in the transitional seasons, and are armed with adaptability and flexibility to weather the storms. While reading this guide, check out your sun, moon, and rising signs for a more complete astrological picture. To find those, input your birthday (date, time, and location) into a free natal chart generator like Cafe Astrology. Editor's Note: The sun sign dates mentioned for each zodiac sign are approximate and can vary by a day or so from year to year. Aries (March 20-April 19) Aries, the cardinal fire sign, ruled by go-getter Mars, is competitive, impulsive, action-oriented, and at times wide-eyed and playful—almost childlike—as the first sign of the zodiac. Aries is associated with the First House of Self and is symbolized by the Ram. In addition to Lady Gaga, other Aries celebrities include Mariah Carey, Diana Ross, and Sarah Jessica Parker. Taurus (April 20-May 20) Taurus, the fixed earth sign, is ruled by Venus, the planet of romance, relationships, beauty, and values, and is a sensual, deliberate, pleasure-seeking, slow-paced, steady, and grounded fan of comfort. Taurus is associated with the Second House of Income and symbolized by the Bull. Some famous Bulls: Adele, Megan Fox, Gigi Hadid, and Jessica Alba. Gemini (May 21-June 20) The mutable air sign Gemini is ruled by Mercury, the planet of communication, transportation, and technology, and is, in turn, buzzy, social, curious, dualistic, adaptable, clever, and a lover of language, word play, travel, and flirtation. Gemini is associated with the Third House of Communication and symbolized by the Twins. Naomi Campbell, Angelina Jolie, and Natalie Portman are all famous Geminis. Cancer (June 21-July 22) Cancer, the cardinal water sign, is ruled by the moon (the emotional compass of astrology, overseeing intuition, nurturing style, and emotions), which imbues Cancer with its sentimentality, love of family and food, sensitivity, compassion, and tendency to be self-protective and security-seeking—not to mention ingratiatingly hilarious. Cancer is associated with the Fourth House of Home Life and symbolized by the Crab. Cancer celebrities include Ariana Grande, Khloé Kardashian, and Selena Gomez. Leo (July 23-Aug. 22) Fixed fire sign Leo is ruled by the sun, which is the luminary that colors self-image, identity, confidence, and purpose, making Leo a highly self-assured, charismatic, optimistic, driven, independent-minded, natural-born leader. Leo is associated with the Fifth House of Romance and Self-Expression and symbolized by the Lion. Dua Lipa, Viola Davis, and Martha Stewart are all famous Lions. Getty Images Virgo (Aug. 23-Sept. 22) Virgo, the mutable earth sign, is ruled by Mercury, the messenger planet that informs communication, thought processes, technology, and transportation. In turn, Virgo is service-oriented, detail-focused, pragmatic, perfectionistic, analytical, sensitive, and thoughtful. Virgo is associated with the Sixth House of Daily Routine and Wellness and is symbolized by the Maiden. Beyoncé may be the most famous Virgo of all time, but she's far from alone; Keke Palmer, Zendaya, and Jennifer Coolidge all keep her company. Related Stories Libra (Sept. 23-Oct. 22) The cardinal air sign Libra is ruled by Venus, the planet of relationships, art, beauty, values, and romance, so it makes sense that Libra is diplomatic, balance- and justice-seeking, romantic, partnership-oriented, and tends to do everything in their power to prize harmony over conflict. Libra is associated with the Seventh House of Partnership and is symbolized by the Scales. Wondering which celebs fall under this sign? Like Bella Hadid, Hilary Duff, Doja Cat, and Brie Larson are all famous Libras. Scorpio (Oct. 23-Nov. 21) Scorpio, the fixed water sign, is ruled by both Mars, the planet of action, energy, and sex, and Pluto, the planet of transformation, power, and control. So it’s no wonder Scorpio is fearless, resolute, intimacy-seeking, private, magnetic, commanding, and comfortable with the shadow side of life, incredibly emotionally intelligent and capable of swimming in the deep end of emotion. Scorpio is associated with the Eighth House of Emotional Bonds and is symbolized by the Scorpion. Gabrielle Union, Tracee Ellis Ross, and Ciara are all Scorp celebs. Sagittarius (Nov. 22-Dec. 21) Mutable fire sign Sagittarius is ruled by Jupiter, the planet of abundance, fortune, expansion, higher learning, and wisdom, which results in Sagittarius being jovial, full of wanderlust, philosophical, opinionated, fun-loving, entertaining, and possessing a “go-big-or-go-home” perspective. Sagittarius is associated with the Ninth House of Adventure and is symbolized by the Archer. Famous Sags include Miley Cyrus, Nicki Minaj, and Janelle Monáe. Getty Images Capricorn (Dec. 22-Jan. 19) Cardinal earth sign Capricorn is ruled by Saturn, the planet of commitment, boundaries, and hard work, which, in turn, makes Capricorn industrious, serious, goal-oriented, pragmatic, practical, organized, and stable. Capricorn is associated with the Tenth House of Career and Public Image and is symbolized by the Sea Goat. Michelle Obama, Kate Middleton, and Gayle King are all top-of-the-field Caps. Aquarius (Jan. 20-Feb. 18) Aquarius, the fixed air sign, is ruled by both Uranus, the planet of innovation, rebellion, and sudden change, and Saturn, the planet of rules, restrictions, and discipline. Aquarius is science-minded, humanitarian, contrarian, quirky, most comfortable with platonic bonds and bringing their skills to the table as part of a team or community. Aquarius is associated with the Eleventh House of Networking and Friendships and is symbolized by the Water Bearer. Elizabeth Olsen, Kelly Rowland, and Shakira are some of the most famous Water Bearers. Pisces (Feb. 19-March 20) The final sign of the zodiac, Pisces, the mutable water sign, is ruled by both Neptune, the planet of dreams and spirituality, and Jupiter, the planet of abundance and fortune. Pisces is compassionate, romantic, imaginative, intensely empathic, sensitive, and invested in healing their own and, perhaps even more so, others’ emotional wounds. Pisces is associated with the Twelfth House of Spirituality and is symbolized by the Fish. Bad Bunny, Drew Barrymore, and Lupita Nyong'o join Rihanna as famous (and rather emotional) Pisces.
